definitions.explanation: Information that helps solve a problem or find something.
Something to hold onto when climbing or moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To search for clues to solve the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there anything that could be a clue?

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}された→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{指紋|しもん}→指紋：12728_shimon⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The only clue to the culprit was the fingerprints left at the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかんで→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: To climb by grabbing handholds on the rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{登|のぼ}れなかった→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: There were no handholds on the cliff, so I couldn't climb it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦わずか→僅か：03792_wazuka⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{手掛|てが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I put my fingers on the slight handholds on the wall and moved up little by little.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{掛|か}かり→掛かる：00711_kakaru⟧ (something to attach to). Has both abstract (clue) and concrete (handhold) senses.

SENSE 1 — CLUE:
- {手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to find a clue
- {手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to obtain a lead
- {手掛|てが}かり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no clue
- {手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかむ→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧: to get a lead

SENSE 2 — HANDHOLD:
- ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手掛|てが}かり: a handhold on a rock
- {手掛|てが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかんで→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb by gripping handholds
